runtime_image_source_note: The subsequent c9507e6 commit changes only report-inventory tooling, tests, and documentation; services and schema sources in the image are unchanged.

logical_restore.method: custom-format pg_dump to a private temporary file, then pg_restore into a template0 database in the same isolated ARM64 PostgreSQL container

application.database_restart_observation: Gateway health returned 200 after PostgreSQL restart. Task/event lease and long-duration provider recovery were not exercised.
application.bootstrap_observation: The app was started before schema replay; background workers logged missing-relation/column errors while the database was still schema-empty. This refresh verified health and protected access after migration, not clean worker startup ordering.

result: ARM64 images, clean schema-only replay through migration 402, zero-pending plans, logical restore with matching migration fingerprint, PostGIS spatial behavior, health, protected-route denial, database restart health recovery, and explicit Compose app recovery passed under emulation.
limitations: This is QEMU/emulator evidence, not Raspberry Pi hardware acceptance, a 4 GB device benchmark, or physical performance evidence.
This current-schema refresh did not impose explicit memory/CPU limits; the previous migration-400 run separately recorded 1.5 GiB PostgreSQL and 1 GiB app limits with two CPUs each.
No seeds, farm data, candidate database, legacy database, Metabase data, or production services were modified.
The initial app-before-migration start emitted worker schema errors; deployments should complete schema bootstrap before starting worker-bearing app services.
No 24-hour run, physical power-loss, real provider recovery, lease recovery, replica failover, or scale-concurrency test was performed.
